description: For supplied effective compilers \(c,b\) and total computable \(F(e,a)\), one can choose an auxiliary index \(r\) for \(\widehat F(e,a)=c(F(b(e),a))\), take the standard primitive-recursive selector \(h(a)=s(d(r),a)\), where \(d(r)=s(r,r)\), and obtain the single total computable \(H(a)=b(h(a))\) with \(\psi_{H(a)}(x)\simeq\psi_{F(H(a),a)}(x)\) for all \(a,x\).
